passage.text: Hi, Emma! I'm at a lake with the photo club.
passage.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈɛmə! aɪm ət ə ˈleɪk wɪð ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌklʌb.

passage.text: It's my first afternoon with the club, and the members are really nice.
passage.reading: ɪts maɪ ˈfɜːrst ˌæftərˈnuːn wɪð ðə ˈklʌb, ənd ðə ˈmɛmbərz ər ˈriːli ˈnaɪs.

passage.text: We're walking around the lake and taking photos of nature.
passage.reading: wɪr ˈwɔːkɪŋ əˈraʊnd ðə ˈleɪk ənd ˈteɪkɪŋ ˈfoʊtoʊz əv ˈneɪtʃər.

passage.text: There are a lot of beautiful trees and flowers here.
passage.reading: ðɛr ər ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈtriːz ənd ˈflaʊərz ˈhɪr.

passage.text: It's very hot, but I'm happy.
passage.reading: ɪts ˈvɛri ˈhɑːt, bʌt aɪm ˈhæpi.

passage.text: Now it's six o'clock, and we're waiting for the sunset.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ ɪts ˈsɪks əˈklɑːk, ənd wɪr ˈweɪtɪŋ fər ðə ˈsʌnsɛt.

passage.text: Look at my photo of the sunset on the lake!
passage.reading: ˈlʊk ət maɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə ˈsʌnsɛt ɑːn ðə ˈleɪk!

passage.text: I love this club, and I want to come again next week.
passage.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ðɪs ˈklʌb, ənd aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈkʌm əˈɡɛn ˈnɛkst ˈwiːk.
